sentences.text: Lewis Carl Davidson Hamilton , MBE -LRB- born 7 January 1985 -RRB- is a British Formula One racing driver from England , currently racing for the Mercedes AMG Petronas team .	MBE	Order of the British Empire	Mercedes	Mercedes AMG Petronas	British Formula One racing driver	Formula One drivers from the United Kingdom	Mercedes AMG Petronas	Mercedes-Benz in Formula One	Formula One	Formula One

A three-time Formula One World Champion , he is regarded by fellow and former drivers as one of the greatest Formula One drivers in the history of the sport .	Formula One World Champion	List of Formula One World Drivers' Champions	Formula One	Formula One

He won his first title with McLaren in 2008 before moving to Mercedes , where he won back-to-back titles in 2014 and 2015 .	Mercedes	Mercedes AMG Petronas	McLaren	McLaren	2008	2008 Formula One season	2014	2014 Formula One season	2015	2015 Formula One season

In December 1995 , at the age of ten , he approached McLaren team principal Ron Dennis at the Autosport Awards ceremony and told him , `` I want to race for you one day ... I want to race for McLaren . ''	McLaren	McLaren	Ron Dennis	Ron Dennis

Less than three years later McLaren and Mercedes-Benz signed him to their Young Driver Support Programme .	Mercedes	Mercedes AMG Petronas	McLaren	McLaren	Young Driver Support Programme	McLaren young driver programme

After winning the British Formula Renault , Formula Three Euroseries , and GP2 championships on his way up the racing career ladder , he drove for McLaren in 2007 , making his Formula One debut 12 years after his initial encounter with Dennis .	McLaren	McLaren	British Formula Renault	British Formula Renault Championship	Formula Three Euroseries	Formula Three Euroseries	GP2	GP2 Series	Formula One	Formula One

Hamilton 's contract for the McLaren driver development program made him the youngest ever driver to secure a contract which later resulted in a Formula One drive .	McLaren	McLaren	Formula One	Formula One
Coming from a mixed background , with a black father and white mother , Hamilton is the first black driver to race in Formula One .	Formula One	Formula One	mixed	British Mixed	black	Black people

Hamilton commented on this , saying `` The way I see it , my colour is an advantage in that it 's something people talk about '' , `` Being the first black man does n't matter much to me personally , but for the sport itself it probably means quite a lot . ''	black	Black people

In his first season in Formula One , Hamilton set numerous records while finishing second in the 2007 Formula One Championship , just one point behind Kimi Räikkönen .	Formula One	Formula One	2007 Formula One Championship	2007 Formula One season	Kimi Räikkönen	Kimi Räikkönen

He won the World Championship the following season in dramatic fashion , becoming the then-youngest Formula One World Champion in history before Sebastian Vettel broke the record two years later .	Formula One World Champion	List of Formula One World Drivers' Champions	Formula One	Formula One	the following season	2008 Formula One season	Sebastian Vettel	Sebastian Vettel

Following his second world title in 2014 , he was named BBC Sports Personality of the Year .	2014	2014 Formula One season	BBC Sports Personality of the Year	2014 BBC Sports Personality of the Year Award

In 2015 , he became the first British driver in history to win consecutive F1 titles , and the second British driver to win three titles after Jackie Stewart .	2015	2015 Formula One season	Jackie Stewart	Jackie Stewart
He also became the first English driver to reach that milestone .
He is the first driver in the history of F1 to have made the podium after starting 20th place or lower at least 3 times .

He is the only driver in the history of the sport to have won at least one race in each season he has competed to date , with McLaren from 2007 until 2012 , and with Mercedes since 2013 .	Mercedes	Mercedes AMG Petronas	McLaren	McLaren
He has more race victories than any other British driver in the history of Formula One .	Formula One	Formula One

His Grand Prix victories is the second highest of all-time having surpassed Alain Prost 's total of 51 at the 2016 Brazilian Grand Prix , behind only Michael Schumacher at 91 .	highest of all-time	List of Formula One Grand Prix winners	Alain Prost	Alain Prost	2016 Brazilian Grand Prix	2016 Brazilian Grand Prix	Michael Schumacher	Michael Schumacher

Hamilton also holds the record for most wins in the season without winning the World Championship , after winning 10 times in the 2016 season where he finished runner-up to teammate Nico Rosberg .	2016 season	2016 Formula One season	Nico Rosberg	Nico Rosberg
